verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents ring-group strategies, whether sequential or simultaneous, and never documents routing unanswered calls to voicemail or an external number. The IVR keypad menu and Queue Callback are related but different routing features. The smart-routing and overflow tutorials are developer building blocks for constructing custom routing through the API, not the product's own capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number
